{{Quote|Preposterous! The Republic can see their power is slipping. Your proposal plays upon our fears of attack to blockade whole systems and leave these planets at your mercy.|Slotho, to Senator Amidala|<ref name="Power Down">{{TCWComicCite|6.45|Power Down}}</ref>}}
'''Slotho''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] negotiator and [[Bail bondsman/Legends|bail bondsman]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Slotho attended a peace [[Conference on Gus Talon|conference]] that was held within an automated [[Gus Talon diplomatic complex|facility]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] to discuss how to respond to recent [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the region. During the meeting, Slotho denounced a proposal from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] delegate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to send a Republic [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] to defend the world.
